recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆橢圓形細胞的細胞質塞滿深紫黑色、粗大密集的嗜鹼性顆粒，幾乎蓋住核，邊界圓滑，是正常肥大細胞（mast cell）；周圍的細胞質深藍、核偏位的細胞是漿細胞，可作為對照。
features: Central oval cell with cytoplasm densely packed with coarse dark purple metachromatic granules that partially obscure the nucleus
Round-to-oval central nucleus, not lobated; no cytoplasmic spindling or hypogranularity
Adjacent plasma cells with deep blue cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hof
Mixed granulocytic precursors with fine pink-purple granules and a cell with coarse strand-like chromatin (possible mitotic figure/disrupted cell) at lower right
Background of red cells and fine granular debris from ruptured cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed hematopoietic population including maturing granulocytic precursors and several plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm. In the center there is a round-to-oval mast cell whose cytoplasm is filled with coarse, dark purple metachromatic granules that partly obscure a round, non-lobated nucleus. The mast cell shows no spindling, hypogranularity or nuclear lobation. The findings represent a morphologically normal bone marrow mast cell; atypical spindle-shaped or hypogranular mast cells in aggregates would be required to raise concern for systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Basophils are smaller with a lobated/segmented nucleus and fewer, larger, water-soluble granules, whereas mast cells are larger with a round nucleus and densely packed granules.

ddx.dx: Atypical mast cell of systemic mastocytosis
ddx.vs: Neoplastic mast cells are spindle-shaped, hypogranular, have bilobed/eccentric nuclei and express CD25/CD2/CD30, unlike this round, fully granulated cell.
Promyelocytes have azurophilic red-purple primary granules, a visible nucleus with a Golgi zone and less dense granule packing.
Macrophages are larger with abundant cytoplasm containing irregular golden-brown to blue-black clumps of variable size plus debris, and are Prussian blue-positive.
